text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Kyoto Shimbun Hai 
drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ââPhew!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I've gotten a pretty good feel 
for the slope. Looks like I can keep an 
accurate pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth is steadily gaining 
strength heading into the Kyoto Shimbun 
Hai. To be honest, her rate of growth far 
exceeded my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the "ensemble with her 
contemporaries" that she started doing a 
little while ago is helping to refine her 
running...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie! I too can feel my melody growing 
richer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur——)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh, isn't that over there—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Now that you've claimed victory in Dubai, 
what race are you targeting next?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Following up on last year, I intend to run 
in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! In that case, is your main rival 
none other than...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...I will not fixate on any specific 
opponent. No matter who I face, I shall 
overpower them head-on.
—Heeey now! Don't be so cold~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're buddies who polished the same iron 
ball together, ain't we~? So let's play 
catch! We'll flip a shogi piece to see who 
goes first!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! It's the fated matchup from last 
year's Takarazuka Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As amusing as ever, aren't you? ......Are 
you entering the "Takarazuka Kinen" this 
year too?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you got that right... I've been 
guided here, after all—by the master of 
Benten Pond.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is a stroke of good fortune—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Then I shall duly return what I borrowed 
from you last year."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Uh, what was it again? An air purifier?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh. ...Please feel free to keep dancing 
your merry little jig for as long as you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me! Fire dancing, 
contemporary— bring on whatever you've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
An' I'm ready to take your hand whenever 
you want, "Gentildonna".

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'll make 'em dance till they're dizzy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"There's still plenty of time until the 
Takarazuka Kinen, but the hype is already 
building up...!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"This generation never runs out of 
material, it's so entertaining...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I look at Gentildonna now, 
there's a race that I just can't help but 
remember――"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Gentil! She's charging straight through 
the middle!! Here she comes, can Gentil 
make it, CAN SHE MAKE IT?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ――Step aside...!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Gentildonna charging in from 
the outside, she's coming, she's coming, 
she's COMING!! She pushes past right 
here!! She has avenged last year's 
defeat!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Fan's Voice A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Alright! Gentil won!! A victory for 
Japanese Umamusume for the first time in 
years!! WOOOOOH!! The Queen reigns 
supreme—!!’"

text_block_list.name: Fan's Voice B
text_block_list.text:
""Aaargh, she's just way too incredible, 
way too beautiful~~!! Lady 
Gentildonnaaa!!! Our glorious Queen~~!!""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna, champion of the Dubai 
International GⅠ. Her running was an 
incredible display that fully proved her 
power as the reigning strongest queen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How domestic racing fans went wild over 
that dramatic victory is still fresh in 
everyone's memory—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—We must follow their example. Those 
girls.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Right now, our generation is lively 
and thriving, with everyone working hard 
and getting hyped up."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Not enough.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
More and more...! Like a raging storm, I 
have to make the audience's hearts 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Just as multiple sounds blend into music! 
A race cannot exist with just one runner 
alone!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Only when there are runners and spectators 
does it truly become a race!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And what this ultimate session needs right 
now is the audience's anticipation for 
these shining runners! Their fervor!! 
Their dreams!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I cannot see the path to reach 
that point—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Every race is a once-in-a-lifetime, 
fleeting moment.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer. Across all the races 
that I and everyone in our generation run, 
I want to keep aiming for the very 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is undeniably a difficult dilemma. 
And Earth's passion for racing and her 
peers is truly incredible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to help her somehow, but given her 
intense passion, I can't afford to say 
anything half-baked...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Haha, if you furrow your brows like that, 
you'll ruin your gentle face, you know?
choice_data_list:
…It's important, so I want to think it 
through properly.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, let's change places and 
think about it together.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Right now happens to be when they are 
in full, beautiful bloom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place Sounds of Earth led me to was a 
certain park. The scent of flowers carried 
on the breeze is so pleasant...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttore, look over there.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Direttrice, look over there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Sounds of Earth 
prompted, a multitude of white and pink 
flowers were blooming in splendid harmony, 
their colors intertwining.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—It's a dogwood. It blooms beautifully, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Out of this whole area, this spot is the 
most beautiful. ...The colors are 
wonderful this year too.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I love you. To an almost fated degree.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The melody of a violin began to 
resonate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Before long, a strange, warm, and 
comforting sensation welled up within my 
chest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I were to put it into words... would it 
be a feeling of "dear affection"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely, this performance must be the 
manifestation of Sounds of Earth's 
feelings toward the dogwood tree.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—To me, the flowering dogwood means 
courage.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Those warm hues always soothe and support 
me... It's a flower that I simply can't 
help but love."
choice_data_list: ...I got the message, loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth's wonderful performance 
conveyed her feelings for the flowering 
dogwood to me far more powerfully than 
words ever could.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, even though I didn't know 
much about dogwoods, I found myself 
growing fond of them—and then, an idea 
strikes me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing next to nothing about music 
myself, hearing her perform for the first 
time allowed me to truly feel the joy of 
music, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was what sparked my interest in her 
running, and now, wanting to match her 
passion, I serve as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In other words, her music holds that much 
'power to connect.' And I am experiencing 
it firsthand right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making up my mind, I told her what came to 
mind. Believing deeply that Sounds of 
Earth was capable of "it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what an incredible race! When the 
favorite missed the break, I wondered what 
would happen, but—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Today was so intense too! Nothing beats 
watching it in person, after all—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
...A violin? That girl, she's a Tracen 
Academy student, right...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Is this for some event? ...Either way, 
you're really good.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(—Now, lining up at the gates are the 
maidens harboring a spectrum of brilliant 
radiance.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Some charge forward with courage to take 
the lead, while others gauge their rivals' 
expressions. As that moment draws near—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Destiny is now unlocked!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? It got so intense all of a sudden. 
That's... so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You're so good at this~! ...Huh? Wait, 
could this be—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(The pack stretches out into a line! 
Cutting through the wind! The sounds of 
galloping feet overlap, as one by one, 
they push forward!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Cutting through the wind, kicking up the 
turf, pinned under piercing gazes—who will 
burst ahead?!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is this... Is this recreating the 
main race from earlier... through music?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! It's seriously popping right into 
my head...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Sweat blazes as I race toward the light! 
The awaiting cheers are far in the 
distance; all that remains is the pulse 
quickening toward victory!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Who, who, who will it be! You, or perhaps 
you! Run, run, run, run on!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Behold! A glorious victory!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheers from the Crowd
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooooh...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I was totally captivated listening to 
that...! It was amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Her expressiveness is out of this 
world...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――Grazie. Thank you for your attention.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Did you notice what just happened?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"That the racing you so love is musica— a 
single piece of music...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —My name is Sounds of Earth!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
One who loves music, and loves racing. And 
an Umamusume running through the Classic 
Class...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Huh, in the Classic Class, huh? I do feel 
like I've seen her somewhere before...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, awesome! That's definitely 
Classic-level material!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To all of you who love racing just as 
much, please, hear what I have to say.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The melody hidden within this year's 
Classic class. Let them show what their 
running, what their passion for racing 
truly is!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sounds of Earth began to tell her 
story through music, accompanied by a few 
gentle words—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The way her classmates run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reasons that each of them held for 
running—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Huh... Looks like there are quite a few 
interesting girls in the Classic class 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The story of that girl they were talking 
about earlier is so good~! Maybe I'll root 
for her a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds of Earth's 'performance' 
resonated within the hearts of the race 
lovers gathered there, raising 
expectations for the Classic stage—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan E
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, did you see this video? The one 
where an Umamusume explains races through 
music!”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan F
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth, right? Yeah, I saw it! 
Her approach is pretty interesting~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to its novelty, the video 
capturing her "performance" spread far and 
wide...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Benissimo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Did you see, Trainer...! People are still 
talking about our last performance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Sounds of Earth going viral as the 
"Umamusume who speaks of racing through 
music," it drew a bit more spotlight onto 
her generation...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can't thank you enough...! It's all 
thanks to your advice! Grazie mille!
choice_data_list:
No, it's all thanks to your strength, 
Earth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is likely the result of Sounds of 
Earth's overwhelming expressiveness, 
combined with her deep love for her 
contemporaries and racing itself.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. That gave me a solid sense of 
progress. Now I know another thing I need 
to work on...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Convey it to the audience through 
music...! Show them who we are as 
performers, passionately!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Things are going to get busy, Direttore. 
Are you prepared...?!"
choice_data_list: If anything, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Things are going to get busy, Direttrice. 
Are you prepared...?!"
choice_data_list: If anything, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Molto bene!! That's the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Kyoto Shimbun Hai right around 
the corner, a new color had been added to 
the sound of Sounds of Earth's footsteps—
